name: rosetta-fairshare-between-two-and-more
code:
use default

fairshare(base: int) -> Pipe[int] =>
    from(0) |> map(count => digit_sum(count, base) % base)

digit_sum(value: int, base: int) -> int =>
    if value == 0 then
        0
    else
        value % base + digit_sum(value / base, base)
    fi

write_line("the first 25 terms of the fairshare sequence:")

[2, 3, 5, 11]
    |> each(people =>
        write_line("  {people,3} people: "
                   "{fairshare(people) |> take(25) |> join(" ")}"))
